title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.39504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. translated_title: PartiCam：基于奖励引导的相机可控视频生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 PartiCam，一种基于粒子滤波的无训练方法，用于改进相机控制的视频生成。对大型视频扩散模型而言，生成严格遵循指定相机轨迹的视频仍然具有挑战性。无需训练的方法与骨干模型无关，且无需构建大规模相机标注数据集，而是在测试时引导预训练模型产生期望的相机运动。这使得生成的相机可控视频数据随后可用于训练相机条件化的视频扩散模型。现有的基于采样的引导方法常常存在轨迹不稳定的问题：它们要么探索过于宽泛而无法遵循目标相机运动，要么过早坍缩并随着时间推移丧失视觉多样性。我们引入了一种面向扩散奖励引导的全局-局部细化框架，从而在视频生成过程中实现精确且一致的相机控制。我们的方（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PartiCam 提出了一种基于粒子滤波的无训练相机控制视频生成方法，通过全局-局部细化的扩散奖励引导框架，解决了现有采样引导方法轨迹不稳定的问题，实现了对大型视频扩散模型精确且一致的相机轨迹控制。
en_tdlr: PartiCam is a training-free, particle filtering-based method that uses a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera trajectory control in video generation while overcoming the unstable trajectories of existing sampling-based guidance approaches.
